title: brief
description: Communication contract. Gate 1 artifact: audience, objective, constraints, desired takeaways.

language.description: Language of ALL deliverables (deck, report), e.g. 'zh-CN', 'en'. Consumers: renderer font selection, docx template/preset choice, every stage's writing language. Explicit at Gate 1 — never inferred downstream.

description.description: Plain-language description of who consumes the artifacts.

objective.description: What this communication is supposed to achieve.

delivery_context.description: When/how the artifacts will be used, e.g. '30-min client review meeting'.

takeaways.description: What the audience should walk away with. The QA reader test compares against these.

hard.description: User hard constraints. Must be deterministically checkable or enforceable; otherwise demote to soft at Gate 1.

dimensions.description: Open vocabulary synthesized by the model (technical_rigor, storytelling, ...). Unknown keys are passed through, never interpreted by code.
